props.heading: Why people come back
props.intro: Three short reasons, each in a sentence or two.

props.title: Made for beginners
props.body: No experience needed. Everyone starts in the same place and goes at their own pace.

props.title: Small groups
props.body: Groups stay small, so there's always time for questions.

props.title: Something to show for it
props.body: You leave with something finished, and the know-how to do it again.
